text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... haa, haa...!
What was my time?
choice_data_list: Unfortunately, it hasn't improved as much as we hoped...
Unfortunately, it didn't drop as much as we'd hoped...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As expected... a more fundamental measure is required.
First, let us analyze my form. The footage, please.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My arms are pinned too tightly to my sides.
I have been conscious of it, but... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being too conscious of it might be the problem.
It looks like overexertion is disrupting your form.
choice_data_list: (...She needs to take a breather.)
(...She really needs a break.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I arrived in casual clothes as requested, but... are we training here?
choice_data_list: I put together a special training regimen.
I put together a special menu for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was just an excuse. I simply wanted her to unwind and refresh.
To prevent her from overthinking it, I decided to keep my true intentions to myself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A special regimen that can be conducted here?
Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
............No, I shall understand soon enough.
Shall we proceed?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: A clothing store... What are we expected to do here?
choice_data_list: Um, what kind of outfits do you usually like?
Um, do you have a preferred clothing style?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let me see... I generally prefer pants.
Clothing that restricts movement does not suit my temperament.
choice_data_list: Why don't we look around and see if there's anything nice?
Want to look around for something good?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
In that case, allow me to accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The summer seasonal items are quite eye-catching.
Though I am currently on a caloric limit, this is rather tempting...
choice_data_list: Why don't we just have a free sample?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please give me a moment to calculate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Calories consumed this morning... and my weekly allowance is—
Calculations complete. I will partake in the warabimochi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, the tension in Ikuno Dictus's shoulders seemed to fade.
However, she still needed one final push...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what is our next course of action?
Considerable time has elapsed since we began browsing shops—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. A bicycle section?
choice_data_list: Oh!! Let's take a look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no better place to put the finishing touches on our 'special regimen.'
Engaging with her cycling hobby should naturally ease any remaining tension.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once she returns to a relaxed, natural state,
she should be able to break through her current plateau.
choice_data_list: I really want to check it out! Will you come with me?
I'd love to take a look! Would you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
If that is the case, I shall gladly accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh... The floor space is modest, but the selection is remarkably authentic.
They even have electronically controlled derailleurs in stock.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is to say, gear-shifting mechanisms.
Though they may look somewhat imposing compared to everyday models.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it looks like futuristic mecha tech. Pretty cool!
Yeah, it looks like a futuristic gadget. Super cool!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...! Do you perceive it as well? This purely functional, streamlined beauty!
It is truly a masterpiece that gathers the very pinnacle of technology.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Observe. That road bike over there is equipped with the exact same component.
It asserts its presence without creating obstruction—truly an ideal form factor.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
One must pay attention to visual aesthetics after all.
The elegance of the components significantly alters one's exhilaration upon riding.
choice_data_list: Ooh, I'd love to try sitting on it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means.
Excuse me, would it be permissible to try this out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was amazed by how perfectly the bike fit. Leaning forward made me feel like a racer.
In my mind, vivid images of picking up serious speed began to form—
choice_data_list: Riding this outside must feel incredible...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, once you experience the actual ride, mere imagination will no longer satisfy you.
When you synchronize seamlessly with your cherished machine and achieve ideal form, it is simply beyond words.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Though only simulated, it will allow you to experience our velocity firsthand.
The sensation of the scenery vanishing behind you... I truly wish for you to experience it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing that would undoubtedly be amazing.
And riding alongside Ikuno Dictus would make it even more enjoyable.
choice_data_list: ...I think I'll buy it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is an exceptionally decisive move.
Are you certain you do not wish to compare it with other bicycles first?
choice_data_list: You praised it earlier, so I trust your judgment.
You spoke so highly of it earlier, so I trust you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, allow me to present helmet options and other gear.
There are several items I would strongly recommend—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded our 'special regimen,' we headed home.
Pushing along a shiny new bicycle that hadn't been with us on the way there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I had not anticipated that the hour would become so late.
I cannot recall the last time I spent half a day simply shopping...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I believe I will be able to fully realize
the intended effects of your 'special regimen.'
choice_data_list: Wait, did you see through it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Regarding your intentions, I deduced them partway through.
It appears I caused you a great deal of trouble; my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I can see it clearly now—just how rigid and tense I had become.
In such a state, it was only natural for my form to deteriorate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting upon it, my focus was narrowed exclusively to charging toward our goal.
Even though taking the shortest, straightest line is not always the correct answer.
choice_data_list: Sometimes you have to relax your shoulders before you can notice that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You understood that even back then,
didn't you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am fine now.
From here on, to ensure I do not forget this lesson—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, let me prove it not through words, but through my running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back at the academy, I began timing her laps.
Just as expected, Ikuno Dictus's speed was noticeably higher.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Power is flowing through her with no wasted effort!
Her form is remarkably natural. At this rate—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Trainer, what was the time?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's a new personal best!
Yeah, you set a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... It felt much closer to the ideal.
Reaching our target time is finally becoming a realistic goal...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It appears your special training regimen was exceptionally effective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing left to worry about.
The Ikuno Dictus of today could undoubtedly hit that target time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And when that moment came, I wanted her to go on the long bike ride she had been looking forward to.
I wished that for her with all my heart.
